text:
leila: alert from security: unexpected IAM grant on KMS cryptoKey key-payments (projects/prod/locations/global/keyRings/payments/cryptoKeys/key-payments) to vendor-sync@partner at 2026-03-20T03:15Z. audit shows iam.setIamPolicy.
trent: that key is used by Vault transit for DB creds and by a couple of backup buckets. we need immediate triage.
ash: pulling audit entry now. snippet:
```
{"method":"google.iam.v1.IAM.SetIamPolicy","principal":"vendor-sync@partner","resource":".../cryptoKeys/key-payments"}
```
rotor-bot: [automated] anomaly score high for vendor principal. recommended snapshot key metadata and generate usage report.
leila: containment proposal: (A) create temporary ops-SA with rewrap rights, (B) revoke vendor binding, (C) rewrap any wrapped ciphertexts, (D) rotate downstream tokens.
oncall: note—full revoke may break backups. propose staged revoke + canary rewrap within 20m window.
trent: agree. enumerate dependent resources:
```
gcloud asset search-all-resources --scope=projects/prod --query="cryptoKeys/name:key-payments" --format=json
```
ash: results: vault-transit-payments, backups-payments-2025, export-bucket-analytics, invoice-func.
vendor-sec: we asked partner; they claim sync job didn't change IAM. need their activity logs.
leila: executing revoke of vendor binding at 4390001305. granting ops-SA for rewrap ops first.
rotor-bot: incident INC-2026-051 created: kms-vendor-grant-suspect. Paging SRE and VendorSec.
oncall: rewrap running with 4 workers. command:
```
./tools/rewrap --src key-payments --dst key-payments-rot2026 --resources ./key-payments-resources.json --parallel 4
```
trent: canary app (invoice-func) swapped keys and smoke passed. vault transit unwrappers tested ok.
ash: audit export uploaded: https://logs.internal/exports/key-payments-439000.json
leila: next steps: 1) complete rewrap for remaining resources 2) rotate service tokens that used KMS-wrapped secrets 3) add alert rule for cross-project/vendor KMS grants 4) retain KMS audit logs 90 days.
vendor-sec: file follow-up with vendor for why their principal had permission; update onboarding checklist to require terraform-locked IAM changes only.
leila: thanks all — keeping thread open for postmortem and runbook updates :thumbsup:
